decisions.reason: Its proven use by a major government customer and connectivity across many APIS schemes make it a core, defensible part of our aviation and border-security portfolio.
With travel-health compliance now a less urgent buyer priority and no clear evidence of strong traction, we would reallocate resources to stronger border-processing and security products.
Cyber security awareness training fits our training capabilities and critical-infrastructure customer base, giving us a relevant and scalable cross-sell despite a competitive market.
Passenger profiling carries high regulatory, reputational, and customer-acceptance risk in our markets, and without visible traction it is not attractive enough to retain.
Document verification remains close to our core offer for transport and border-related clients, and the dedicated platform indicates a product with continued strategic value.
